|prev=12w16a |next=12w18a |nextparent=1.3.2 }} '''12w17a''' is the third [[snapshot]] for [[Java Edition 1.3.1]], released on April 26, 2012.{{citation|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120427014334/https://www.mojang.com/2012/04/minecraft-snapshot-12w17a/|title=Minecraft Snapshot 12w17a|author=Jens Bergensten|website=Mojang.com|date=April 26, 2012}} == Additions == === Blocks === [[File:Oak Slab JE1.png|36px]] '''[[Wooden Slab|Wooden Slabs]]''' * Slabs for each of the four types of wood added. ** New block IDs 125 for double wooden slabs and 126 for single wooden slabs. ** These new slabs no longer act like stone. ** An [[axe]] should be used to break them. ** They are no longer immune to [[fire]] and [[lava]]. ** Wooden slabs created in older versions of ''Minecraft'' are still stone-like and fireproof and don't change to the new slabs when placed or mined. === Items === [[File:Book and Quill JE1 BE1.png|32px]] '''[[Book and Quill|Book and Quills]]''' * Editable books, crafted using a [[book]], [[feather]], and [[ink sac]]. ** When a book and quill is made, it can be right-clicked to open a screen that allows player to type in the book. ** Pressing "Done" saves whatever was typed and allows player to edit the book again later, yet does not "sign" it. ** When "signing" a book, it allows player to choose a title up to 16 characters long and disable editing of the book, the book and quill then becomes a written book, with the icon changing along with the label. [[File:Written Book JE1 BE1.png|32px]] '''[[Written Book]]''' * Looks the same as a regular book, but has a shine like an enchantment. * After being finished, the written book cannot be edited again. === Commands === '''General''' * {{cmd|help}} and alias {{cmd|?}} added. === General === '''[[Options]]''' * Added 'Chat Options'. ** Added chat opacity, letting the chat be semi-transparent. ** Added chat disabling, removing the chat for Multiplayer servers. ** Added chat colors option. ** Added "Only Commands" mode to chat. == Changes == === Blocks === [[File:Ice JE2.png|36px]] '''[[Ice]]''' * Ice no longer turns into [[water]] in [[the Nether]]. {{Animate|Oak_Sapling_(texture)_JE4_BE2.png;Birch_Sapling_(texture)_JE1_BE1.png;Spruce_Sapling_(texture)_JE1_BE1.png;Jungle_Sapling_(texture)_JE1_BE1.png|36px}} '''[[Sapling]]s''' * Now have their proper names (e.g. "Spruce Sapling"). === Items === [[File:Book JE1 BE1.png|36px]] '''[[Book]]s''' * Now require [[leather]] to craft. '''[[Tool]]s''' * Now have infinite [[durability]] in Creative mode. === Mobs === [[File:Chicken JE1 BE1.png|36px]] '''[[Animal]]s''' * Livestock, such as [[chicken]]s, can now be "walked through" instead of pushing the player around in crowded pens. === Non-mob entities === {{Animate|Oak Boat JE1.png;Minecart JE3 BE1.png|36px}} '''[[Boat]]s and [[minecart]]s''' * Can now be destroyed in one hit in Creative mode. === Gameplay === [[File:Bonus Chest.png|36px]] '''[[Bonus chest]]''' * The player can no longer have a bonus chest in Hardcore mode. '''[[Creative mode]]''' * Flying through water in Creative mode is no longer slow. '''[[Enchantment]]s''' * [[Silk Touch]] can now retrieve [[ice]] and [[glass pane]]s. === Command format === '''General''' * Server commands now appear in ''italics'' in multiplayer. == Fixes == '''3 bugs fixed''' * Fixed entity collision errors. * Fixed the pick block function. * Fixed chat issues. == References == {{reflist}} == Navigation == {{Navbox Java Edition versions|1.0}} [[Category:Java Edition 1.3.1 development versions]] [[Category:Versions using legacy download site]] [[Category:Java Edition development versions released in 2012]] [[de:12w17a]] [[es:Java Edition 12w17a]] [[fr:Édition Java 12w17a]] [[it:Java Edition 12w17a]] [[ja:Java Edition 12w17a]] [[ko:Java Edition 12w17a]] [[nl:12w17a]] [[pt:Edição Java 12w17a]] [[ru:12w17a (Java Edition)]] [[uk:12w17a (Java Edition)]] [[zh:Java版12w17a]]

{{Infobox version |title=Minecraft 12w21a |image=12w21a Banner.png |image2=Java Edition 12w21a.png |edition=java |type=Snapshot |parent=1.3.1 |date=May 24, 2012 |clientdl={{cdl|omniarchive|archive/java/client-release/1.3/pre/12w21a.jar|Client}} ([https://meta.celestia.sh/versions/v1/12w21a.json .json]) |serverdl={{cdl|omniarchive|archive/java/server-release/1.3/pre/12w21a.jar|Server}} |exedl={{cdl|omniarchive|archive/java/server-release/1.3/pre/12w21a.exe|.exe}} [[Category:Versions using legacy download site]] |prevparent=1.2.5 |prev=12w19a |next=12w21b |nextparent=1.3.2 }} '''12w21a''' is the sixth [[snapshot]] for [[Java Edition 1.3.1]], released on May 24, 2012,{{cite|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120525103351/https://www.mojang.com/2012/05/minecraft-snapshot-week-21/|title=Minecraft Snapshot Week 21|website=mojang.com}} which added emeralds, ender chests, and more stairs. == Additions == === Blocks === '''[[File:Emerald Ore JE1.png|36px]] [[Emerald ore]]''' * Drops 1 [[emerald]] when mined. * Generates in blobs of up to 10 blocks. '''[[File:Ender Chest JE1 BE1.png|36px]] [[Ender chest]]''' * Crafted with 8 [[obsidian]] and 1 [[eye of ender]]. * All ender chests in a [[world]] have the same contents, if those contents change it affects the contents of all other ender chests. * On [[multiplayer]], the ender chest's contents are the same for all players on a server. * Emits light level of 7 '''[[File:Sandstone Stairs JE1.png|36px]] [[Sandstone stairs]]''' * Have the same function and recipe as other [[stairs]], but made of [[sandstone]]. === Items === '''[[File:Emerald JE1 BE1.png|36px]] [[Emerald]]''' * Dropped when mining an [[emerald ore]] block. * Used in villager [[trading]]. '''[[File:Enchanted Golden Apple JE1 BE1.gif|35px]] [[Enchanted golden apple]]''' * A second type of golden apple made with [[blocks of gold]]. * After being consumed, the player receives 30 seconds of Regeneration IV, plus Resistance and Fire Resistance for 5 minutes. === World generation === '''[[Desert temple]]s''' * New generated structure in desert biomes that resemble pyramids. * Have a [[TNT]] trap and loot chests inside. '''Desert [[village]]s''' * Villages that generate in desert biomes now are made of sandstone rather than wood and cobblestone. === Gameplay === '''[[Trading]]''' * Villagers buy or sell the player [[emerald]]s in exchange for certain items. * Trade with villagers by right-clicking on them, opening up a GUI with one buying slot and one selling slot. === Command format === '''[[Command]]s''' * {{cmd|seed}} ** Displays the current world seed. == Changes == === Blocks === [[File:Dispenser_(S)_JE2_BE1.png|36px]] '''[[Dispenser]]s''' * Eject [[water]] and [[lava]] source blocks from buckets. * Also take water and lava source blocks if there is an empty bucket inside. [[File:Gravel_JE4_BE3.png|36px]] '''[[Gravel]]''' * Changed texture from [[File:Gravel_JE3_BE2.png|36px]]. [[File:Placeholder_Block_JE1_BE1.png|36px]] '''[[Locked chest]]''' * The old [[chest]] textures have been removed; locked chests now [[Java Edition placeholder texture uses#Blocks|use the placeholder block texture]]. === Items === [[File:Bucket_JE1_BE1.png|36px]] '''[[Bucket]]s''' * Now stackable to 16. === Mobs === '''[[Passive mobs]]''' * Can be easily pushed around by simply walking. This eases navigating through animal farms. === Non-mob entities === [[File:Oak_Boat_JE1.png|36px]] '''[[Boat]]s''' * Now pass through [[lily pad]]s without breaking the boat; the lily pad drops as an item instead. [[File:Minecart_JE3_BE1.png|36px]] '''[[Minecart]]s''' * While sitting inside of a minecart, pushing the directional keys makes it move the direction player is pressing. This only works while the minecart is sitting on rails. === Gameplay === '''[[Singleplayer]]''' * The local server no longer runs in a separate Java process, despite still requiring a separate JAR. '''[[Creative]]''' * Added [[snow]] to the Creative inventory. '''[[Sky]]''' * [[Stars]] are more realistic. ** They are now slightly smaller and slightly brighter. === Command format === '''[[Command]]s''' * {{cmd|ban}} ** Added optional reason parameter. ** Ban reasons are displayed when players attempt to rejoin the server after being banned. ** [[Hardcore]] death bans now specify the reason "Death in Hardcore" === General === '''[[Game Menu]]''' * The quit button once again properly reads "Save and Quit to Title". '''[[Options]]''' * Improved options menu. '''[[Debug screen]]''' * The F3 menu no longer has the frame time graph. == Trivia == * In this version, when loading a singleplayer world, one needs to put minecraft.zip/server/minecraft_server.jar into .minecraft/server manually to continue loading. == References == {{Reflist}} == Navigation == {{Navbox Java Edition versions|1.0}} [[Category:Java Edition 1.3.1 development versions]] [[Category:Java Edition development versions released in 2012]] [[de:12w21a]] [[es:Java Edition 12w21a]] [[fr:Édition Java 12w21a]] [[it:Java Edition 12w21a]] [[ja:Java Edition 12w21a]] [[ko:Java Edition 12w21a]] [[nl:12w21a]] [[pt:Edição Java 12w21a]] [[ru:12w21a (Java Edition)]] [[th:รุ่น Java 12w21a]] [[uk:12w21a (Java Edition)]] [[zh:Java版12w21a]]

'''12w22a''' is the eighth [[snapshot]] for [[Java Edition 1.3.1]], released on May 31, 2012.<ref>{{cite|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120601154733/https://www.mojang.com/2012/05/minecraft-snapshot-week-22/|title=Minecraft Snapshot Week 22|website=mojang.com}}</ref>

== Additions ==
=== Blocks ===
'''[[File:Tripwire.png|36px]] [[Tripwire]] and [[File:Tripwire Hook JE1.png|36px]] [[tripwire hook]]s'''
* String can be placed down to create tripwire. When walked on, these can activate tripwire hooks if there is a hook at each end of the string.

'''[[File:Block of Emerald JE1 BE1.png|36px]] [[Block of emerald]]'''
* Decorative storage blocks, crafted with 9 [[emerald]]s.

=== World generation ===
'''[[File:Jungle pyramid JE1 BE1.png|36px]] [[Jungle temple]]'''
* Generated structure that generates in jungle biomes.
* Comprised mainly of [[cobblestone]] and [[mossy cobblestone]].
* Have dispenser and tripwire traps and chest loot.

=== Gameplay ===
'''[[Adventure]] mode'''
* New gamemode, only accessible with {{cmd|gamemode 2}}.
* The player cannot break or place any blocks.
* The player can interact with any blocks, like doors and levers, and can buy from [[villager]]s.
* The player can still damage mobs.

'''[[Creative inventory]]'''
* Added potions, found in "Brewing" category.
* Added [[armor]] slots, 2x2 [[crafting grid]], and an option to delete items in Survival inventory when in [[Creative]].
* Added [[cobblestone monster egg]], [[stone brick monster egg]] blocks and [[charcoal]] to the Creative inventory.

=== Command format ===
* Added {{cmd|defaultgamemode}} command.

== Changes ==
=== Blocks ===
{{Animate|Cauldron JE5.png;Water Cauldron (level 1) JE1.png;Water Cauldron (level 2) JE1.png;Water Cauldron JE1.png|36px}} '''[[Cauldron]]'''
* When exposed to [[rain]], cauldrons have a chance to fill with water.

[[File:Emerald Ore JE2 BE1.png|36px]] '''[[Emerald ore]]'''
* Now generates in blobs of 1 block.

{{Animate|Oak Leaves JE3 BE4.png;Birch Leaves JE1 BE2.png;Spruce Leaves JE1 BE2.png;Jungle Leaves JE1 BE2.png|36px}} '''[[Leaves]]'''
* Rain slowly drips through leaves.

'''[[File:Locked chest JE3.png|36px]] [[Locked chest]]'''
* Top texture changed from [[File:Placeholder Block JE1 BE1.png|36px]]
* Changed as a result of the addition of the texture of what would later become the [[block of emerald]] occupying the texture space of what used to be the chest texture.

{{Animate|Oak Slab JE1.png;Birch Slab JE1.png;Spruce Slab JE1.png;Jungle Slab JE1.png;Cobblestone Slab JE2 BE2.png;Smooth Stone Slab JE1 BE1.png;Stone Brick Slab JE1 BE1.png;Brick Slab JE2 BE2.png;Sandstone Slab JE3 BE5.png|36px}}'''[[Slab]]s'''
* Can now be also placed upside-down when pointing at the upper half of the side of a block, instead of only the bottom. This does not work with stairs.

=== World generation ===
'''General'''
* Some minor terrain changes.{{more info}}

=== Gameplay ===
'''[[Enchanting]]'''
* Enchantment system has been rebalanced.
** The maximum enchantment level has been lowered from 50 to 30.
*** As a result enchantment tables now require only 15 bookcases around them to allow maximum level enchantments.
** With a full [[enchantment table]] set with [[bookshelves]], at the bottom of the 3 enchantments, it always shows the player the highest number possible.
** Using level 30 enchantments, the player has a lot more luck; almost all items get at least 2 enchantments.
** Various actions now reward the player with [[experience orb]]s, such as mining [[ore]]s (except [[gold ore]] and [[iron ore]]), using [[furnace]]s, and getting [[achievement]]s.
** Levels are now awarded linearly. It takes 17 [[experience]] to go up one level.

'''[[Inventory]]'''
* Blocks seen in inventory are oriented to the right instead of to the left.

'''[[Nether portal]]s'''
* Have a very small chance of spawning [[zombie pigmen]].

'''[[Singleplayer]]'''
* Pausing now works again in singleplayer.

'''[[Smelting]]'''
* Smelting in a furnace with a lava bucket now leaves an empty [[bucket]] for the player to retrieve.

'''Villager [[trading]]'''
* Added the 10 gravel + 1 emerald → 2-3 flint trade to farmers.
* Added the enchanted item trades to clerics (e.g. 1 iron pickaxe + 3 emeralds → 1 iron pickaxe with Fortune I).
** Includes iron sword, iron pickaxe, iron axe, iron chestplate, diamond sword, diamond pickaxe, diamond axe, and diamond chestplate.
* Added the 1 emerald → 5 [[arrow]]s trade.
* Switched the 2 [[eyes of ender]] → 1 emerald to 7-10 emeralds → 1 eye of ender.
* Removed the 36- 63 [[rotten flesh]] → 1 emerald trade.

=== General ===
'''[[Controls]]'''
* Pressing {{key|F}} reloads the [[chunk]]s.

== Fixes ==
'''10 bugs fixed:'''
* In the "Redstone" tab of the Creative inventory, the redstone torch is now on instead of being off.
* In the "Decoration Blocks" tab of the Creative inventory, the redstone torch has been removed.
* Fixed the size of slimes which was sometimes wrong in the previous snapshot.
* Fully charged arrows now show their particle effect again.
* Arrows are now stuck at the correct position in the block they hit.
* The language "English (US)" is available again.
* Fixed [[enderman]] often not shaking and opening their jaws when looked at.<ref>{{tweet|evilseph|207996349088673792|Made Enderman scarier (or maybe just as scary as some people are used to...)}}</ref>
* Fixed repeaters sometimes being stuck when loading the chunks they are in.<ref>{{tweet|dinnerbone|207933814641659905|Hey redstoners (... what?), let's all go give 
@shadowjay1 a big hug for helping to fix the bug where diodes get stuck on load.|archive=yes}}</ref>
* The search tab does not automatically open up unless the player presses their chat key, allowing the inventory to be closed with the normal inventory key again.
* Fixed bug causing stacked buckets to disappear when used to milk cows.</onlyinclude>

'''12w49a''' is the first [[snapshot]] for [[Java Edition 1.4.6]], released on December 7, 2012,<ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20121209202854/http://www.mojang.com/2012/12/minecraft-snapshot-12w49a</ref> which added Nether brick slabs, enchanted books and fireworks.

== Additions ==
=== Blocks ===
[[File:Nether Brick Slab JE1 BE1.png|width=32x32]] '''[[Nether brick slab]]s'''
* New kind of [[slab]].
* Made by using 3 [[nether bricks]] blocks in a horizontal line.
* Came from a suggestion at [[Minecon 2012]].<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YG9RNyRhIow&feature=youtu.be&t=1499</ref>

=== Items ===
[[File:Firework Rocket JE1 BE1.png|width=32x32]] '''[[Firework rocket]]'''
* New kind of shootable projectible.
** Sound effects will come soon.
* Fireworks are customizable by crafting.

[[File:Firework Star JE1 BE1.png|width=32x32]] '''[[Firework star]]'''
* Used for crafting [[firework rocket]]s.

[[File:Enchanted Book JE1 BE1.png|width=32x32]] '''[[Enchanted book]]s'''
* Used for [[enchanting]] items.
** In this snapshot due to a bug, any item could be given any enchantment in Survival mode using an [[anvil]].

== Changes ==
=== Blocks ===
'''General '''
* When holding {{ctrl|sneak}}, the player can place blocks and items (like [[redstone]], [[repeater]]s, and [[lever]]s) directly onto blocks such as [[crafting table]]s, [[furnace]]s, and [[dispenser]]s.

'''[[Cobweb]]s'''
* Can be harvested utilizing [[Silk Touch]] shears.

=== Items ===
'''[[Shears]]'''
* Can now have the [[Silk Touch]] enchantment by using the [[anvil]].

=== Mobs ===
'''[[Ghast]]s'''
* The blast radius of [[fireball]]s a specific ghast shoots can be customized with an editor.

== Removals ==
=== General ===
'''[[Java Edition distance effects/Historical effects|Distance effects]]'''
* [[Falling block]] behavior has changed - they are no longer capable of infinitely producing dropped items at high coordinate values.

'''13w01a''' is the first [[snapshot]] for [[Java Edition 1.5]], released on January 3, 2013.<ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20130106004940/http://www.mojang.com/2013/01/minecraft-snapshot-13w01a/</ref> It mainly added an assortment of new [[redstone components]]. This is the first snapshot released in 2013.

== Additions ==
=== Blocks ===
'''[[File:Nether Quartz Ore JE1 BE1.png|32px]] [[Nether quartz ore]]'''
* New ore exclusive to the Nether.
* Drops 1 [[Nether quartz]] item when mined.
* Generates around [[netherrack]].

'''[[File:Block of Redstone JE1 BE1.png|32px]] [[Block of redstone]]'''
* Stores redstone dust similar to [[blocks of diamond]], etc.
* Emits constant redstone power.
* Works as a pushable redstone power source.

'''[[File:Daylight Detector.png|32px]] [[Daylight sensor]]s'''
* Output power while receiving sunlight.
* The level varies depending on the time (more sunlight = more redstone power), and it does not function at night.

'''[[File:Hopper (D) JE1.png|32px]] [[Hopper]]s'''
* Places and takes out items in hoppers, [[chest]]s, [[furnace]]s, [[minecarts with chests]], [[dispenser]]s, and [[brewing stand]]s.
* Allows for the automation of many processes.
* Still a work in progress (as indicated by the inventory icon [[File:Hopper (item) JE1.png|32px]]).

'''[[File:Redstone Comparator (S) JE1.png|32px]] [[Redstone comparator]]'''
* Has 3 inputs and 1 output. Input from the back is considered signal A, and whichever side gives the stronger signal is considered signal B.
* Has 2 modes: comparison and subtraction.
* In comparison mode, if A≥B, the output is A, otherwise output stays off.
* In subtraction mode, if A≥B, the output is A-B, otherwise output stays off.
* Replacement for the "capacitor" idea.

'''[[File:Trapped Chest.gif|32px]] [[Trapped chest]]s'''
* Gives out a signal depending on the amount of players looking inside. 1 player = 1 strength signal, 2 players = 2, etc.
* Crafted with a [[chest]] and a [[tripwire hook]].
* Large trapped chests can be staggered with large chests to allow more compact storage.
* Texture is slightly different than a normal chest, with a red stain around the latch.

'''[[File:Light Weighted Pressure Plate JE1 BE1.png|32px]] [[File:Heavy Weighted Pressure Plate JE1 BE1.png|32px]] [[Weighted pressure plate]]s'''
* Detects item stacks.
* [[Light Weighted Pressure Plate|Gold]] version reaches full strength at 60 items.
* [[Heavy Weighted Pressure Plate|Iron]] version reaches full strength at 600 items.
* Linear, so 10 strength signal means twice as many items as a 5 strength signal.

=== Items ===
'''[[File:Nether Brick JE1 BE1.png|32px]] [[Nether brick]]'''
* Used for crafting [[Nether bricks]].
* Obtained by smelting [[netherrack]].

'''[[File:Nether Quartz JE1 BE1.png|32px]] [[Nether quartz]]'''
* Item dropped from [[Nether quartz ore]].

== Changes ==
=== Blocks ===
'''[[File:Locked chest JE4.png|32px]] [[Locked chest]]s'''
* Texture for the block was changed from [[File:Locked chest JE3.png|32px]].

'''[[Piston]]s'''
* Are more stable from previous versions.
** Sticky pistons are less sticky.{{info needed}}

'''[[Redstone circuits]]'''
* Are now more consistent.

=== Items ===
'''General'''
* Now shows the item name in-game.

=== Gameplay ===
'''[[Death messages]]'''
* Now show the weapon someone was killed with.{{info needed}}

'''Inventory management'''
* Double-click items to fill the stack up as much as possible.
* Drag item stacks around{{info needed|left mouse button?}} to divide them up over the dragged-over slots.
* Drag item stacks around with {{mouse|right}} to place one of that stack in each dragged-over slot, if that slot is not occupied already.
* Shift double-click an item stack to move all other item stacks of that kind to that part of the inventory.
* Press {{key|Q}} while the mouse is over an item in the inventory or a container to drop it.

== Bugs ==
* [MC-5711] Redstone torches attached to the side of a block do not pop off if the block supporting them is destroyed.
* [MC-5721] Dragging to spread an item out in the Creative inventory, then clicking on the inventory tab, and placing the 0 stack item down, the game crashes.
* [MC-5728] Infinite loop caused by subtraction mode comparators causes the world to be unplayable.
* Mineral duplication: players can exponentially dupe minerals by putting then in a crafting table with a block of their material, then double clicking on a mineral in the crafting table, works on the same principle as the method below.
* Crafted item duplication: any stackable crafted item can be duplicated by setting up its recipe in a crafting table, then double clicking an existing version of this item in the inventory. Requires at least one of that item to be present in the inventory.

** An empty map has no data on it until the player right clicks with it.
** The point on the player's world where the player right clicked it is the map's center.
* A map (with data) can be cloned. Cloned maps are stackable.
* Maps can be zoomed out (but not zoomed in).
'''[[Potion]]s'''
*The [[potion of Night Vision]] can now be brewed by adding a [[golden carrot]] to an [[awkward potion]].

=== Mobs ===
'''General'''
* Mobs (and all other entities) can travel through [[Portal|portals]].

'''[[Villager]]s'''
* The particle effect when a trade with a [[Villager]] has been successful has changed.

=== General ===
'''[[Debug screen]]'''
* f: item on the debug screen now shows the exact [[Facing|direction]] the player is looking, between -180 and 180 degrees from the south.
* {{key|F3+P}} toggles the auto-pause when the window loses focus (mainly for debugging).
* {{key|F3+H}} toggles detailed item descriptions (also for debugging).

== Fixes ==
'''4 bugs fixed'''
* Fixed zombies not [[Fire|burning]] in the [[sun]].
* Fixed graphical glitch with [[chest]]s and [[ender chest]]s.
* Fixed crash bug with [[beacon]]s.
* ''[12w32a]'' [[Silk Touch]] now works again.</onlyinclude>

== Trivia ==
* This snapshot is one of only three snapshots for {{JE}} to have its digits consecutively increasing by one. The only other snapshots to have this property are [[Java Edition 12w34b|12w34b]] and [[Java Edition 23w45a|23w45a]].

'''12w36a''' is the fourth [[snapshot]] for [[Java Edition 1.4.2]], released on September 6, 2012,<ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20120907124808/http://www.mojang.com/2012/09/minecraft-snapshot-12w36a/</ref> which adds wither skeletons and mob heads, makes the wither spawnable, makes beacons craftable, adds the wither painting, carrots on a stick and the nether star.

== Additions ==
=== Blocks ===
'''[[Mob heads]]'''
* Five types in this version:
** {{BlockLink|Skeleton skull}}
** {{BlockLink|Wither skeleton skull}}
** {{BlockLink|Zombie head}}
** {{BlockLink|Creeper head}}
** {{BlockLink|Player head}}
* Wither skeleton skulls are dropped very rarely by [[Wither Skeleton|wither skeletons]].
* Other heads are only available via the [[Creative inventory]].
* Can be equipped in [[helmet]] slot.

'''{{ItemLink|Painting}}'''
* Added one new painting depicting the creation of a [[wither]].

=== Items ===
'''{{ItemLink|Carrot on a stick}}'''
* Used to maneuver [[pig]]s.
* Can also attract pigs.
* Main purpose is to control [[Saddle|saddled]] pigs while [[Riding|ridden]].

'''{{ItemLink|Nether star}}'''
* Used as a [[crafting]] ingredient for the [[beacon]] block.

=== Mobs ===
'''[[File:Wither Skeleton JE1 BE1.png|36px]] [[Wither skeleton]]s'''
* Only [[Mob spawning|spawn]] in [[the Nether]].
* Give [[Player|players]] [[Wither effect]] when [[Melee attack|hitting]] them.
* Carry and rarely [[Drops|drop]] [[Stone Sword|stone swords]] when killed by players.
* Drop [[bone]]s and [[coal]].
* Have a high chance to spawn from a [[skeleton]] [[spawn egg]] if used in the Nether.
* Wither skeletons can replace skeletons on [[spider jockey]]s.
** Spawned by using a [[spider]] spawn egg in the Nether.

== Changes ==
=== Blocks ===
'''{{BlockLink|Beacon}}'''
* New model and textures.
* Can now be crafted by surrounding a [[nether star]] with 3 blocks of [[obsidian]] on the bottom and 5 blocks of [[glass]] around the top.

=== Items ===
'''{{ItemLink|Carrot}} '''
* Now found in [[Village|villages]].
* Can be used to [[Breeding|breed]] pigs.

'''{{ItemLink|Golden carrot}}'''
* Retextured.

'''{{ItemLink|Leather armor}}'''
* Now uses two overlayed textures, one being the [[Dye#Dyeing armor|color]].
* Minor changes to the leather dyeing – colors attempt to maintain intensity and not dilute as much.

'''[[File:itemSprite potato.png]] [[Potato]]es'''
* Now found in villages.

=== Mobs ===
'''{{EntityLink|Blaze}}'''
* Spawn a bit less often in [[Nether Fortress|nether fortresses]] (chance decreased from 43.5% to 35.7%).

'''{{EntityLink|Chicken}}'''
* Now use [[seeds]] instead of [[wheat]] to breed.
* They follow the player when a seed is in hand.

'''{{EntityLink|Magma cube}}'''
* Are slightly rarer in nether fortresses (chance decreased from 13% to 10.7%).

'''{{EntityLink|Pig}}'''
* Can be bred with [[carrot]]s.
** Can no longer be bred with wheat.
* If saddled, now always drop their saddle on [[death]].

'''{{EntityLink|Skeleton}}'''
* [[Geared mobs#Picking up gear|Picked up items]] now always drop on death.

'''{{EntityLink|Wither}}'''
* Player needs to place 4 pieces of [[soul sand]] in a vertical T-shape and place 3 [[wither skeleton skull]]s on top to create it.
* Drops one [[nether star]] upon death.
* When spawned in the [[Overworld]], the [[sky]] gets [[Sky#Colors|darker]].
* Gives players [[Wither (effect)|Wither]] II [[effect]] when hitting them.
* Its name is now displayed correctly above its HP bar.

'''{{EntityLink|Zombie}}'''
* Model and texture changed.
** No visual difference, except that it breaks old [[Texture pack (Java Edition)|texture packs]].
* Picked up items now always drop on death.

'''{{EntityLink|Zombie pigman}}'''
* Appear a lot less often in [[nether fortress]]es (chance decreased from 43.5% to 17.9%).
* Model and texture changed.
** No visual difference.</onlyinclude>

* This is the first version to not have bug fixes.
